book.celestial.all_knowing_tome.story:
Part 1

Long ago, since the days of Atraxia, gods and humans lived and ruled side by side. They gave ordinary folk a fragment of their power: the favor of the gods, the anvil on which Hephaestus himself forged, and a book in which every divine enchantment is written. But then the cursed ones came, led by Hades and his servants: the All-Knowing Angel, who could not withstand the hellfire; the Ever-Hungry Cerberus, Hades' personal pet; and Fenrir, a giant wolf who could not stand against Hades himself and fell under the control of his curse. For a time the gods of Celestia were able to hold them back, but with the passing years their power began to fade, and they left the people. At least, that is what the people thought. In secret, the gods created a creation of their own, one that could stand against the curse and keep it at bay: the God of Celestia. But the people, believing they had been abandoned, created one more being with their last breath: an immortal man, who can learn anything he wishes and have as much power as he needs... And into his mind they forged a single command: kill the gods of Celestia. The immortal man was called the God Slayer, and that name helped him in the struggle. The God of Celestia, hearing of the new threat, created a Guardian to protect him, but the Guardian failed. Thanks to a fragment of the Guardian of Gods, the God Slayer was able to enter Celestia, find the God and kill him. But the God's soul did not find peace. Something in the God Slayer changed. He felt a strange feeling that ordinary words cannot describe, and the restless soul of the dead god felt it too, and settled on the shoulder of its killer, and began to help him in the many adventures that await him in the fight against the curse, which for many millions of years had been waiting for the fall of the God of Celestia... Part 2

And so it began: the curse crawled out of the depths of hell. Three of Hades' servants led this assault. The All-Knowing Angel settled in his lair, a mystical library holding all knowledge of the past and the future. But the Guardian of Atraxia, as the restless soul named him, stopped the Angel from continuing his journey across the fields and forests of wondrous Atraxia. Thanks to a gift from the gods, the book that the gods had given the old inhabitants of Atraxia, he was able to reach the lair of the cursed Angel and defeat him. But the end of the road was still far away. After the Angel was killed, the library fell empty, and strange eyes appeared in the sky: Hades himself was watching and rubbing his hands, eager to destroy the pitiful creation of the Atraxians. Next on the path was Cerberus, the three-headed hound, who was personally hunting for the Guardian of Atraxia to kill him. But the Guardian lured Cerberus in with the forbidden fruit and managed to defeat him. When Cerberus fell, a very loud cry was heard: "NOOOOOOO!" It was Hades himself, sitting in his castle: he had lost the dearest creature of his life. But one last hope remained, Fenrir, the giant wolf who could stop the flow of time on the earth at any moment. Yet with the help of a mysterious clock, the Guardian managed to reach Fenrir's domain. The domain itself was strange, unlike those of the other servants, but the Guardian did not care, and thanks to his strength and the gifts of the gods he managed to defeat him. Hades, sitting in his castle, realized that something terrible was coming... Part 3

Hades began to wait for the arrival of the new Deity, who had destroyed everyone he had counted on. Meanwhile the Guardian of Atraxia was preparing: he made new armor and sharpened his paxel, won in blood, while the restless soul of the god waited for this moment, and it was drawing ever closer. Soon the eyes began to watch the new Deity ever more closely, the Bloody Deity, as Hades, the God of Death and Hell, personally named him. On that very day, with the help of the cursed one's soul, the Guardian of Atraxia found a loophole. "Teleportation is possible!" the soul cried out, knowing that soon Celestia would sleep in peace. Combining all the artifacts he had gathered, the All-Knowing Tome of the Angel, the Heart of Cerberus and Fenrir's Clock, he managed to do it: the cursed matter carried him to Him. Hades himself was waiting for the Bloody Deity, but he could not begin the fight without the consent of the hero of this story. Once the consent was given, the battle began, and it lasted a long time, even by the standards of gods, but the Guardian of Atraxia was finally able to defeat the God of Hell. After his death, a portal to the homeland of Atraxia appeared. After everything that had happened, the Guardian of Gods, the hope of the soul, began to understand that he was only a toy in the hands of someone greater. "Cut!" something cried from behind the curtains, and the story came to its end...
